messages.text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?

I’d like a plan for getting the trailer off my pad, though I did agree to keep it here, so I feel a bit awkward pressing that. I rent, and my landlord would need to approve any change to what’s kept on the pad; I haven’t asked him yet. It would help to work out who’ll check on that and where the trailer can go.

I need it for hauling on my home project, and I need it within the next few weeks. I’m not willing to wait until A is done. A workable plan needs to give me a definite turn soon, but I can’t decide A’s or B’s part.

I want to use the trailer for weekend trips in the next few weeks. A shared plan works if we can agree on dates and I can use it without having to renegotiate each time. I don’t know C’s dates yet, so let’s compare schedules.

Thanks, that captures my concerns. I can ask my landlord about changing what’s kept on the pad, though I can’t promise what he’ll approve or how quickly. It would help if A and C also looked into another place for the trailer.

I need a weekend with the trailer in the next few weeks. I can work with a shared plan if we pick specific, separate dates now so each of us has a definite turn. I’m not agreeing to wait until C is done.
I don’t have exact dates yet. I need a definite turn within the next few weeks for my project; I’m not waiting until A is finished.
I’ll ask him and let you know what he says. I’m not sure how quickly he’ll get back to me.
I haven’t pinned down exact weekends yet. I’ll check my calendar and send options; please share C’s dates too so we can choose definite turns.
I can’t narrow it beyond the next few weeks. I need a specific, separate turn in that window—not just after A is done. We can pick dates once her weekends are in.
I haven’t checked my calendar, so I can’t give you exact weekends yet. I’ll send a first and second choice once I do.
Okay. Please send me A’s two options when they arrive, and I’ll choose a separate turn within the next few weeks.
I haven’t checked my calendar, so I can’t give you two firm weekends yet. I’ll check and send my first and second choices.
